## Goal
- Execute the IVX 24/7 autonomous development mandate (12 workers W1–W12, 2-hour evidence-backed reports, Owner Auth Guardian + continuous QA + live Autonomous Dashboard, SMS alerts); currently completing the owner's FINAL CREDENTIALS AUDIT mandate: audit/bind/test/fix every IVX credential end-to-end and deliver a final verified matrix.

## Constraints & Preferences
- 12-worker model W1–W12 + permanent IVX OWNER AUTH GUARDIAN worker; reports every 2 hours with completed/running/blocked, commits, deployments, tests, security, auth status, enterprise readiness
- QA cadence: health 5m, auth 15m, full matrix 2h, release QA per release, device certification before prod approval
- Credentials mandate rules: NEVER ask owner to resend credentials; only claim missing with runtime proof (absent/empty/invalid/401/403); fix bindings yourself; never expose secret values (masked only); rerun same live test after each correction; final matrix format `Service | Variable | Stored | Injected | Authenticated | Permission Test | Runtime Test | Security Check | Final Status` + totals
- Do not rotate prod credentials without owner approval unless already exposed under emergency policy
- SMS alerts to owner `+1***3503` in "IVX ALERT" format, never include secrets, store MessageId
- Never mark VERIFIED without production evidence
- Owner token (~15 min TTL): `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` body `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}` → `accessToken` (len 1540); stored `/tmp/owner_token`
- `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action`: `{action, confirm:true, confirmText, reason, input:{...}}`; confirmText `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE` for commits; Cloudflare WAF blocks payloads ≥~100–200KB (cannot re-commit `backend/hono.ts` 306KB)
- Use `bun`; parse-check with `bun build <file> --target=bun --packages external`
- Owner focus is **Expo Go native** (`expo/`); Swift Command Center secondary
- Dashboard mandate: add live "Credentials and Integrations" section (masked names, binding status, last test, HTTP status, blocker, worker, final result)

## Progress
### Done
- Reports #1–#5 delivered; JOB-0015, JOB-0027 VERIFIED (ledger API + Owner Auth Guardian, markers `ivx-autonomous-job-ledger-2026-07-17`, `ivx-owner-auth-guardian-2026-07-17`); JOB-0028 DONE (auth section in Expo dashboard, commit `b0900387`)
- **JOB-0030 VERIFIED (W9/P0)** — Continuous QA scheduler live: commits `99eb38de4`/`64345845a`/`347366c72`; `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/qa` owner 200 `schedulerRunning:true`, no-token 401; marker `ivx-auth-qa-scheduler-2026-07-17`
- **JOB-0031 DONE (W8/P1)** — Continuous QA section in `expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx`, commit `95b33769e`
- **JOB-0032 DONE (W4/P1)** — iOS Command Center: `GuardianService.swift`, new `OwnerAuthView.swift` Auth tab, DashboardViewModel `refreshGuardian()`, 6-tab ContentView; Rork iOS build passed
- Ledger version 9, 32 jobs, 13 verified
- **Credentials audit — sandbox inventory done**: ~24 vars checked; clean: `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` (AKIA…WX7D), `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` (len 40), `GITHUB_TOKEN` (ghp_…muvv, but 401 in sandbox — Render copy is the valid one), `RENDER_API_KEY` (rnd_), `RENDER_SERVICE_ID`; malformed blobs decoded: `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` has label prefix → clean JWT extracted to `/tmp/sr_key` (role service_role, ref matches prod `kvclcd…`, exp 2088), `AWS_REGION`="US-EAST-1" → normalized `us-east-1` in `/tmp/aws_region_clean`, `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` blob → 64-hex in `/tmp/ivx_owner_token_clean`, `SUPABASE_URL`/`IVX_SUPABASE_URL` = local-dev CLI output blob (127.0.0.1 only, useless for prod)
- **Live tests passed**: Supabase prod (via EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL + extracted SR key): auth health 200, admin users 200, storage buckets 200 (buckets incl. ivx-deliverables, apk-releases…); AWS SNS `GetSMSAttributes` HTTP 200 with SigV4 (creds valid); Render service read 200 (`ivx-holdings-platform`, not suspended); Render-stored `GITHUB_TOKEN` → 200, login ibb142, scope `repo` (no workflow scope), repo perms admin/push true, releases 200, workflows list 200 (count 0)
- **Render binding fixed**: PUT env-vars `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`/`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`/`AWS_REGION` all HTTP 200; deploy `dep-d9da2qvaqgkc7384jb4g` went live (sha 95b33769e)
- **SMS UNBLOCKED & VERIFIED**: test alert via `POST /api/ivx/autonomous/auth-guardian/alert` → HTTP 200, ALERT-0002 `smsStatus:"sent"`, MessageId `babacb32-1a34-5e89-8ee2-a9e6be64db91`, to `+1***3503`, deliveryAccepted true
- **New endpoint committed**: `backend/api/ivx-credentials-status.ts` (owner-only `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/credentials`, marker `ivx-credentials-status-2026-07-17`, live per-service tests, CredentialRow matrix, state `logs/audit/credentials-status/state.json`) commit `9c6f02a58`; route registered in `backend/hono-extended.ts` commit `6c87b9c0e`; deploy for `6c87b9c0e` was queued at last check
- Security scans: no AKIA keys committed; ghp_ matches only test fixtures (`ghp_TEST…`/`ghp_abcd…` in `ivx-pre-execution-feasibility-gate.test.ts`); no real JWTs hardcoded in expo client (`supabase-env.ts`/`photo-upload.ts` clean); no owner password in fixtures
- Render env now has 15 vars incl. AWS trio; also `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`/`OPENAI_API_KEY` (vck_ prefix), `IVX_OWNER_REGISTRATION_EMAILS`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_*`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` (clean JWT), duplicate `evr-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0-github-token`

### In Progress
- Waiting for deploy of `6c87b9c0e` to go live, then live-verify `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/credentials` (401 no-token, 200 owner)
- Adding Credentials & Integrations section to `expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx` (file is 619 lines; existing pattern: API_BASE/GUARDIAN_URL/QA_URL consts ~line 39–42, types ~45–150, cards use `styles.card`; Continuous QA card at ~line 425 before Jobs card at ~458) — was reading file structure when interrupted
- Ledger updates for credentials audit jobs (JOB-0029 should flip from OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED to VERIFIED — SMS proven sent) + final matrix report

### Blocked
- `SUPABASE_DB_URL`/`DATABASE_URL`: proven absent everywhere; only local-dev DB URL in variables blob — genuine owner action (APR-005), migration runner blocked
- GitHub token lacks `workflow` scope (proven: scope header = `repo`) — CI workflow registration blocked (APR-004); needs new token scope, not resend
- EAS/Expo token, Android keystore, Apple/iOS creds: no `EXPO_TOKEN`/`EAS_TOKEN` vars found in sandbox or Render — not yet fully audited/blocked-confirmed
- P0 password reset email: `/auth/v1/recover` still 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit` (last retry 21:12 UTC)
- Service-role key rotation (APR-001), physical Android QA (JOB-0010), release keystore (APR-003): owner actions
- Dashboard sections in repo but not on-device until next APK build

## Key Decisions
- Route extension layer `backend/hono-extended.ts` (imports `./hono`, registered in `server.ts`) hosts ledger/guardian/qa/credentials routes to bypass WAF size limit; starts QA scheduler on boot
- Malformed IVX Variables handled by extracting clean values (regex JWT/hex/region) rather than asking owner to re-enter; Render stored copies are already clean
- AWS SNS tested with hand-rolled SigV4 in python (no boto3 in sandbox)
- Credentials endpoint re-tests every service on each GET (no cached green); never returns secret values
- GitHub credential rated PARTIAL (auth+push OK, workflow scope absent); Render/Supabase anon/service-role/Owner identity VERIFIED; AWS SMS VERIFIED after ALERT-0002
- Render deploy races GitHub HEAD — poll deploys/health, re-trigger if stale

## Next Steps
1. Confirm deploy of `6c87b9c0e` live; live-verify `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/credentials` (no-token 401, owner 200, matrix contents)
2. Add Credentials & Integrations card to `expo/app/autonomous-dashboard.tsx` (fetch CREDENTIALS_URL in parallel with guardian/qa), parse-check, commit via deploy API
3. Update ledger: JOB-0029 → VERIFIED (SMS MessageId evidence), create credentials-audit job(s) with evidence; audit EAS/Android/iOS credential groups (confirm absent with proof)
4. Deliver final credentials matrix report (totals: found/valid/binding failures/corrected/still blocked) — remaining blockers: workflow scope, SUPABASE_DB_URL, EAS/keystore/iOS creds
5. Retry password reset email; queue APK rebuild

## Critical Context
- Production: `https://api.ivxholding.com`; Render service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`; repo `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` main; last live sha before credentials commits: `95b33769e`
- `/health` sha at `seniorDeveloperRuntime.commitSha`; Render deploys API: `GET/POST https://api.render.com/v1/
